items.title: 14.1 Layers of the atmosphere (atmosphere ki layers) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.1 with Figure 14.1, printed page 306.

blocks.text: Atmosphere ki chaar alag layers (tahein) hain. Yeh layers is baat se pehchani jati hain ke oonchai (altitude) barhne ke saath temperature kaise badalta hai.

blocks.alt: Neeche daen zameen ka gol hissa aur oopar neela aasman. Zameen ke qareeb se ek lambi tirchhi lakeer oopar jati hai jise chaar label wali lakeerein kaatti hain jo oonchai ko layer ke naam se jorti hain: 0-12 km Troposphere, 12-50 km Stratosphere, 50-85 km Mesosphere aur 85-600 km Thermosphere.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.1: Atmosphere ki layers (kitab ki Figure 14.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se oopar chaar layers hain: troposphere (0-12 km, mausam isi mein hota hai), stratosphere (12-50 km, ozone layer yahin hai), mesosphere (50-85 km, sab se thandi) aur thermosphere (85-600 km). Kitab ki figure mein mesosphere '50-80 km' aur thermosphere '80-600 km' likha hai, jabke kitab ka apna text 85 km kehta hai; hamari drawing mein text ke mutabiq 50-85 km aur 85-600 km likha hai.

Yeh atmosphere ki sab se neeche wali layer hai jo 12 km tak jati hai. Atmosphere ki sab major gases, jaise nitrogen, oxygen aur carbon dioxide, isi mein hain. Is layer mein temperature 17 °C se -58 °C tak barabar kam hota jata hai. Yeh sab se densest (ghani) layer hai. Barish, bijli (lightning) aur toofan (hurricanes) jaise bare mausam ke events isi layer mein hote hain.

Troposphere ke oopar stratosphere hai, jo zameen ki surface se 12-50 km oopar hai. Is mein temperature -58 °C se -2 °C tak barhta hai. Sooraj ki ultraviolet (UV) radiations kitni pohnchti hain, is hisab se stratosphere ke teen hisse hain. Oopar wale hisse mein ozone sooraj ki zyada energy wali UV radiations absorb (jazb) karti hai aur toot kar monoatomic oxygen (O, akela atom) aur diatomic oxygen (O₂) ban jati hai:

Darmiyani stratosphere mein UV radiations kam guzarti hain. Yahan monoatomic oxygen aur diatomic oxygen dobara mil kar ozone banati hain. Yeh exothermic reaction (garmi dene wala reaction) hai, aur isi se ozone layer banti hai:
Neeche wale stratosphere tak bohat kam UV radiations pohnchti hain, is liye yahan monoatomic oxygen nahi hoti aur ozone bhi nahi banti.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Stratosphere neeche se nahi, apne andar se garam hoti hai: ozone UV absorb karti hai aur O₂ + O ka dobara milna garmi chhorta hai. Isi liye is layer mein oonchai ke saath temperature barhta hai.
Yeh zameen se taqreeban 50-85 km ki oonchai tak hai. Yahan oonchai ke saath temperature -2 °C se -93 °C tak girta hai. Atmosphere ka sab se thanda hissa isi layer mein hai.

Yeh zameen ki surface se 85 km se 600 km tak hai. Is layer mein oonchai barhne ke saath temperature barhta hai. Is ki wajah zyada energy wali ultraviolet (UV) aur X-rays ka absorb hona hai. Oopar wale thermosphere mein temperature 500 °C se 2000 °C ya is se bhi zyada ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Troposphere mein oonchai ke saath temperature girta hai magar stratosphere mein barhta hai. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Troposphere neeche se, garam zameen se, garam hoti hai, is liye oopar jate hue thandi hoti hai. Stratosphere ki ozone UV radiations absorb karti hai aur O₂ + O → O₃ ka exothermic reaction garmi deta hai, is liye stratosphere apne andar se garam hoti hai aur oonchai ke saath temperature barhta hai.

items: Troposphere 0-12 km: temperature girta hai, sab se ghani, mausam isi mein.
Stratosphere 12-50 km: temperature barhta hai; ozone: O₃ → O₂ + O aur O₂ + O → O₃.
Mesosphere 50-85 km: sab se thandi (-93 °C). Thermosphere 85-600 km: 500-2000 °C, UV aur X-rays absorb.
